subject: Add CMake build system for valkey (#1196)
reason: The change only adds a CMake build system: new CMakeLists.txt files, cmake modules, a cmake-format config, CI workflow and README/gitignore updates. The sole source-file hunk (src/server.c) removes one blank line before a comment, which cannot alter behavior. No command, reply, replication, persistence or cluster code path changes, so there is nothing for a runtime scenario to exercise.
